Get sufficient category statistics from a data frame

Source: R/basics.R
get_sufficient_category_statistics.Rd

Calculates sufficient statistics for specified cues for all categories and optional groups in a data frame.

Usage

get_sufficient_category_statistics(
  data,
  cues,
  category = "category",
  group = NULL,
  stats = c("n", "mean", "cov", "css", "uss"),
  simplify = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame or tibble.

cues

Character vector of column names for cues. Required.

category

Character string specifying category column name. Default: "category".

group

Optional character vector of group column name(s). Default: NULL.

stats

Character vector of statistics to return. Allowed values are "n", "mean", "cov", "css", and "uss". Default: c("n", "mean", "cov", "css", "uss").

simplify

Logical. If TRUE (default) and the data matches a single category and group with a single statistic, returns an atomic scalar, vector, or matrix. If FALSE, always returns a tibble.

...

Additional arguments (e.g. model_family).

Value

If simplify = TRUE and a single statistic is selected for a single category and group, the atomic numeric value, vector, or matrix. Otherwise, a tibble with the grouping columns and requested

See also

get_exposure_category_statistics

Examples

# Example with synthetic phonetic data
df <- data.frame(
  category = rep(c("b", "p"), each = 20),
  vot = c(rnorm(20, 0, 10), rnorm(20, 50, 10)),
  f0 = c(rnorm(20, 200, 20), rnorm(20, 240, 20))
)
get_sufficient_category_statistics(df, cues = c("vot", "f0"))
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   category     n mean      cov           css           uss          
#>   <chr>    <int> <list>    <list>        <list>        <list>       
#> 1 b           20 <dbl [2]> <dbl [2 × 2]> <dbl [2 × 2]> <dbl [2 × 2]>
#> 2 p           20 <dbl [2]> <dbl [2 × 2]> <dbl [2 × 2]> <dbl [2 × 2]>
